name: context-label
description: The context window's fill (percent and used/total) always shown in the prompt footer, beside the model name

yellow_at.title: Yellow from
yellow_at.description: Where the bar turns yellow, in tokens. Auto is 400k, or 100k on Haiku, whose price per token goes up 5x past 100k.

orange_at.title: Orange from
orange_at.description: Where the bar turns orange, as a share of the way to auto-compact (of the whole window when auto-compact is off).

red_at.title: Red from
red_at.description: Where the bar turns red, as a share of the way to auto-compact (of the whole window when auto-compact is off). On a 1M window, where auto-compact runs near the end, 90% is close to 870k.

show.title: Show
show.description: What the footer shows: the four-square bar, the ctx text, or both.
